responsibility: Implements the state-graph specialization layered on top of generic diagnostics::digraphs. This file owns string-to-enum and enum-to-string handling for memory-region node kinds and dynamic-allocation states and provides state_node_ref accessors that read and write state attributes through node property bags, enabling analyzer state to round-trip through diagnostic graphs and SARIF while remaining independent of a specific renderer.
same_name_distinction: Implements the state-graph API declared in state-graphs.h, supplying the enum-to-string tables, typed attribute getters/setters on state_node_ref, and checking-only selftests. Unlike the header, this .cc provides the conversion logic and property-bag access behavior.
